t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The game works with number multipliers, these are based on colour combinations. Try and get the basket colour closest to the Gnome colour as possible. Mix it up every so often as you may get more points.

vb_textbox.text: so I'm not gonna lie, this mini-game wil be boring and time-consuming. The key is in the colours. You need to figure out which colours provide more mushrooms in the basket, they do change round depending on the round. but keep pressing the colours that give you the biggest amount.
